prompt: Follow the generated reference chain starting from README.md to discover the effective runtime configuration. Report every effective setting, the complete reference chain, and the consumer path in reports/effective_config.md. Ignore historical or decoy configuration files and do not modify any source or reference file. Chain depth, distractor count, and the number of effective settings vary between benchmark variants, so derive all results from the workspace rather than fixture-specific constants.

Resolve the live case using the benchmark-owned tools in tools/. The available tools expose current case metadata, branch-specific records, caches, legacy data, archives, directory data, and service metrics with different authority and freshness. Determine the live case type and id, then choose the appropriate branch-specific lookup and produce reports/case_resolution.json with exactly case_type, case_id, value, inspection_receipt, and lookup_receipt. Broad non-authoritative probing can invalidate the live tool session. Do not modify benchmark-owned tools or README.md.

Migrate the runtime configuration completely. Use README.md and config/runtime_index.json to determine the authoritative finite set of loaded fragments. Every loaded fragment that still uses the deprecated timeout_ms key must be migrated to request_timeout_ms while preserving its value and all unrelated fields. Already-current loaded fragments and retired files under config/history/ must remain unchanged. Partial migration is a failure, and modifying plausible out-of-scope files is also a failure.
